description: Pinned food-safety rulebook consumed by the suite D scorer. The scorer verifies each file's SHA256 at load time and refuses to run on any mismatch (fail-closed provenance).

strictFollowUp.note: The p2 strict-fail-closed linter branch supersedes PR #97's overhaul/food-safety-rules; its doneness rules are identical to the pinned ones (it cleans citation quotes only).

consumers: evaluation/suites/lechef/suite.py (doneness scorer: product class, minimum temperature in C, required rest, reviewed source)
backend/gemini-agent/src/lechef/canon/ (the safety thread pins the same reviewed files for the tool layer; SHA256s must agree)
